fullDesc: Learn how to implement, validate, analyze and report website and marketing performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Looker Studio. This practical Google Analytics 4 & GTM course teaches business measurement planning, event-based tracking, Google tag configuration, website conversions, audience analysis, campaign attribution and performance reporting. Develop hands-on skills in configuring GA4 properties, creating measurement plans, implementing events through Google Tag Manager, troubleshooting tracking issues and validating data quality. Understand privacy-aware measurement, consent signals, UTM governance, cross-domain measurement fundamentals and the limitations of digital attribution. Analyze website traffic, user engagement, marketing channels, funnels and key events using GA4 Reports and Explorations. Create stakeholder-ready dashboards in Looker Studio and translate performance data into meaningful business recommendations. Build a professional analytics portfolio containing an end-to-end measurement plan, validated event tracking implementation, a measurement quality audit and an interactive business performance dashboard. The course emphasizes accurate tracking, responsible data collection and actionable insights rather than simply installing tracking codes or reporting vanity metrics.
overview: The Google Analytics 4 & GTM certification programme equips digital marketers, analysts, website managers, and entrepreneurs with rigorous, end-to-end digital measurement capabilities. Grounded in the core philosophy: 'Measure correctly. Understand user behavior. Convert data into better business decisions', the curriculum guides students through measurement framework architecture, GA4 property setup, Google Tag Manager event deployment, data layer fundamentals, consent mode governance, GA4 Explorations, and stakeholder reporting in Looker Studio. Students graduate with a 4-part client-ready measurement portfolio and preparation for the Google Analytics Skillshop assessment.
why_now: Third-party cookie deprecation, privacy regulations (GDPR, DPDP), and the shift from session-based Universal Analytics to event-driven GA4 have transformed digital measurement. Businesses can no longer rely on vanity pageviews or generic tracking scripts. High-growth organizations demand analysts who can architect custom event schemas, deploy tags via GTM, validate data integrity in Tag Assistant and DebugView, respect user consent signals, and build executive Looker Studio dashboards that translate complex behavioral telemetry into profitable business decisions.

faq.question: What is the Google Analytics 4 & GTM course?
faq.answer: The Google Analytics 4 & GTM course is a practical, 6-week (48 instructional hours) certification programme designed to teach students how to architect digital measurement plans, configure GA4 properties, deploy event tracking via Google Tag Manager (GTM), audit tracking quality and privacy compliance, perform advanced funnel analysis in GA4 Explorations, and build executive reporting dashboards in Looker Studio.

faq.question: Is this course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The course begins with digital measurement fundamentals, business KPIs, and event concepts before advancing into Google Tag Manager tag configuration, debugging, and Looker Studio dashboards. While no prior analytics experience is required, basic familiarity with websites and digital marketing concepts is helpful.

faq.question: What is the duration and fee?
faq.answer: The course duration is 6 Weeks (48 total instructional hours across 6 comprehensive modules). The course tuition is an institutional fee of ₹7,900 (plus applicable GST). In accordance with Nova Skills Truth in Pricing policy, there are no artificial countdown discounts, inflated strike-through comparisons, or hidden fees.

faq.question: What is the difference between GA4 and GTM?
faq.answer: Google Tag Manager (GTM) is a tag management system used to deploy, configure, and manage tracking codes (tags, triggers, and variables) on a website without constantly editing website source code. Google Analytics 4 (GA4) is an analytics platform that collects, stores, processes, and visualizes the measurement data sent by those tags. In professional workflows, GTM collects and dispatches data, while GA4 reports and analyzes it.

faq.question: Will I learn Google Analytics setup?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn end-to-end GA4 property setup from scratch, including creating accounts and web data streams, configuring Measurement IDs, setting 14-month data retention, establishing internal IP traffic filters, defining unwanted referral exclusions, registering custom dimensions and metrics, and configuring Key Events.

faq.question: Does the course teach event tracking?
faq.answer: Yes, event tracking is at the core of the GA4 data model. You will master automatically collected events, enhanced measurement events, Google's recommended events (such as generate_lead, view_item, sign_up), and how to build custom events with specific event parameters to measure unique user actions like button clicks, video plays, and downloads.

faq.question: Will I learn Google Tag Manager practically?
faq.answer: Yes. You will get extensive hands-on experience inside Google Tag Manager configuring Google tags, GA4 Event tags, click triggers, form submission triggers, user-defined variables, and dataLayer variables. You will also master GTM Preview mode and Tag Assistant to test and verify tag execution before publishing versions.

faq.question: Does the course include conversion tracking?
faq.answer: Yes. The course thoroughly covers Key Events (GA4's modern terminology for conversions), event counting methodologies (once per event vs. once per session), custom conversion criteria, and how GA4 Key Events relate to and differ from Google Ads conversions and imported bidding goals.

faq.question: Will I learn consent mode and privacy-aware measurement?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 04 specifically covers privacy regulations (GDPR, DPDP), Google Consent Mode fundamentals (analytics_storage, ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization), basic vs. advanced consent mode, consent signal debugging in Tag Assistant, and strict policies prohibiting Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from being passed into GA4.

faq.question: Does this course cover Looker Studio?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 06 is completely dedicated to Looker Studio. You will learn how to connect live GA4 data sources, build executive scorecards, design time-series charts and acquisition tables, add interactive date and channel filters, write basic calculated fields, and structure stakeholder-ready dashboards that present clear business narratives.

faq.question: Are real practical projects included?
faq.answer: Yes. You will complete four substantial, client-ready portfolio deliverables: (1) an End-to-End Business Measurement Plan, (2) a Validated GA4 & GTM Event Tracking Implementation with DebugView evidence, (3) a GA4/GTM Tracking Quality & Privacy Audit Report, and (4) an Interactive Looker Studio Marketing Performance Dashboard.

faq.question: Will I learn Google Ads campaign management?
faq.answer: No. Campaign management, ad copywriting, keyword bidding, and media buying are owned by Course 31: Google Ads Performance Specialist. This course (Course 37) specializes exclusively in digital analytics, tracking implementation, data validation, and performance reporting. Campaign specialists rely on analytics specialists to ensure their conversions are tracked accurately.

faq.question: Does the course require coding?
faq.answer: No advanced programming or software development experience is required. All GTM workflows use GTM's visual interface, built-in triggers, and standard CSS selectors. Foundational web concepts (HTML elements, basic JavaScript dataLayer snippets, and JSON data structures) are explained clearly from a marketer's and analyst's perspective.

faq.question: Will I receive an official Google Analytics certification?
faq.answer: The course includes guided preparation and curriculum alignment for the official Google Analytics certification available on Google Skillshop. The official Google credential must be earned independently by passing Google's free online assessment on Skillshop. Upon completing the course and submitting your 4 portfolio deliverables, Nova Skills awards an institutional Certificate of Completion in Google Analytics 4 & GTM.

faq.question: What career opportunities are available?
faq.answer: Graduates are equipped for roles such as Junior Digital Analytics Specialist, GA4 Implementation Executive, Web Analytics Executive, Marketing Reporting Specialist, and Freelance Analytics Consultant. Typical entry-to-intermediate analyst salaries in India range from ₹3.8L to ₹7.5L per year, with freelance implementation projects commanding ₹20,000 to ₹50,000 per setup.
